card.name: Physical layout of sites and buildings
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods and linking words in travel or history descriptions of buildings, ruins, and places. The next sentence is likely to describe a structure, such as steps, a platform, or paving.

modes.label: Period after place description
modes.description: A full stop ending a sentence about location, access, or layout of a site.
modes.example: A steep climb on foot is the only way up to the monastery<<.>> There are about 50 nuns

modes.label: Words inside layout details
modes.description: A word or word start within a physical feature such as steps, paving, or an arch.
modes.example: There is an arch opening into this pond and<< steps>> leading down into the water.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for structures and access features, such as platform, steps, and concrete.
card.plain: It fires in descriptions of how a site or building is laid out, and prepares the text to name structures like steps or platforms.
